correctness.rationale: PASS. Directly reconstruct L(x)=sum_{j<m}x_j+b x_m and its exact drift delta-(x_{m-1}-c)^2. Below delta<0 forces L(F^n x)<=L(x)-n(a*-a), hence linear norm escape; for arbitrary invariant probability bounded increasing arctan(L) gives strict integral contradiction without moments. At delta=0 telescoping on bounded trajectories makes x_{n,m-1}->c, and shifts make all coordinates converge; invariant probability invariance with arctan(L) gives the sole atom. Above delta>0 solves two real fixed points. Critical centered Jacobian P is a primitive stochastic m-cycle/(m-1)-cycle companion with stationary vector (1,...,1,b)/S, yielding simple center eigenvalue 1 and all transverse eigenvalues <1. Normalized center Q solves (P-I)Q=e1-e/S with Q_{m-1}=((m-1)(m-2)/2-b)/S^2; cubic parabolic iterate z'=z-z²/S-2Hz³/S³+O(z^4) yields the log coefficient S+2H=(m-1)^2-b. Local strong-stable tracking extends to every bounded orbit except exponentially converging ones. Independent SymPy exact drift and Q residual for all 3<=m<=12 tested with multiple rational b, without pretending this finite test proves the asymptotic.
